thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — page fired for service=auth-service metric=token_validate.error_rate > threshold (last 5m). Priority: P1. @oncall-ian paged.

pagerduty: [automated] Triggered: auth.token.validate.failure_rate.esc. See: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345

oncall-ian: acked. I'm on it, starting triage.

oncall-ian: quick skim — seeing a lot of 'kid not found' in auth-validate logs, plus 502s upstream.

sre-anya: jumping in. can you paste logs / sample error?

oncall-ian: logs snippet:```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z auth-validate ERROR token validation failed: kid not found (kid: "abc123")
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z jwks-fetch INFO fetched jwks keys: ["def456","ghi789"]
```

eng-ml-rob: that timeline matches a key rotation we ran at 10:10. jwks publisher should include both old+new for overlap. looks like old kid isn't in JWKS.

prod-support-luis: CS: multiple customers reporting login failures and 401s on API calls. Flagging as customer-impacting. Drafting status page note.

incident-bot: Escalation: no mitigation after 3m — paging SRE lead.

sre-anya: Ok, quick plan: 1) check auth-signer health, 2) confirm JWKS endpoint, 3) force re-publish including archived keys, 4) reduce jwks cache TTL to 10s at CDN edges if possible, 5) if needed enable fallback key acceptance temporarily.

oncall-ian: running:```
curl -s https://auth.redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"def456"
"ghi789"
```
No "abc123" present.

eng-ml-rob: confirmed: abc123 is the previous signing key. It should have been retained for 24h during rotation. Looks like prune logic removed it prematurely.

sre-anya: mitigation options: a) re-add the old key to JWKS (fast), b) rollback rotation (slower), c) accept old tokens by fetching pubkey from KMS (risky). Let's re-add to JWKS now.

oncall-ian: are we able to hotpatch the jwks publisher?

eng-ml-rob: pushing hotfix: auth-jwks-publisher v2.3.1-hotfix to include archived keys for 24h. Starting deploy.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started by eng-ml-rob — auth-jwks-publisher v2.3.1-hotfix (canary -> prod).

prod-support-luis: update: CS notes — ~12 active sessions affected, ~5 integration pipelines failing. Posting to status page now.

eng-ml-rob: deploy finished. publisher reports success. re-fetching JWKS:```
curl -s https://auth.redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"abc123"
"def456"
"ghi789"
```

sre-anya: monitoring auth-validate logs.

oncall-ian: error rate dropping — last 2m error rate 0.8% from 6.2% peak.

customer-success-kim: customer A confirmed logins restored. CS following up with affected customers and remediation steps.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved. Incident transitioning to post-incident review.

sre-anya: handoff: eng-ml-rob owns root-cause + follow-up. oncall-ian will write initial timeline. Action items: 1) revert prune behavior in rotation script, 2) add canary propagation check that validates JWKS consistency across regions before pruning, 3) add jwks divergence metric and alert, 4) add unit/integration tests for rotation path. eng-ml-rob please open GH issues and link here.

eng-ml-rob: will open RFC + 3 GH issues now and assign. preliminary root cause: concurrency bug in publisher's prune routine removed recently-rotated keys instead of waiting retention window.

prod-support-luis: CS follow-up: compiling customer impact list and credit recommendations. will coordinate with finance.

oncall-ian: marking thread for follow-up in postmortems channel. thanks all for quick response :heart: :thumbsup:

incident-bot: note: next steps — schedule postmortem within 48h, include timeline, customer impact, remediation, and verification steps.
